args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. The deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback succeeded (`status: rolled_out`), and verification shows the service is now **healthy** with error rate 0.002 across all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy, but it was a staging release, so it wasn't relevant to the production rollback target.
